architectureDecisions: ProductHistoryHead is the sole product completeness/currentness cursor: CAS {generation, commitRef, historyDigest}; commits are immutable and predecessor-linked.

Closure-relevant history includes accepted semantic claim/obligation currentness, product artifact revisions, DeploymentRelease/QualityAcceptance, and acceptance-policy/waiver revisions; execution strategy/policy changes alone are excluded.
BB-055 research may read BB-052/BB-054 READY plans as planned dependency contracts; WORKER waits for BB-054 DONE and then uses delivered truth.
All closure-relevant publishers and projection/closure rechecks share one project ProductHistory mutation guard, so a newer authoritative transition cannot coexist with an older stable history basis.
If durable authority heads are ahead of ProductHistoryHead after a crash, projection is RECOVERY_REQUIRED/NOT_READY until deterministic reconciliation appends the missing immutable transition.
ProductAcceptanceAuthority is separate immutable policy/waiver evidence behind a CAS head; the resolver derives the complete applicable waiver set.

ProductStateProjection is a deterministic disposable reduction over ProductProjectionSubject = exact history head + acceptance-authority head + waiverSetDigest. Builder input is product/root only, never caller-selected current refs.

ProductOutcomeClaim is immutable historical evidence bound to one eligible projection subject. Closure revalidates exact history/policy/waiver currentness under guards immediately before publication; later product/policy drift makes the old claim non-current without mutating it.
implementationSlices: G1 — Product history [AC-1, AC-2, AC-5, AC-7, AC-8, INV-1, INV-2, INV-4, INV-8]: add product-history.js with immutable transitions/commits, CAS ProductHistoryHead, shared mutation guard, deterministic digest, and canonical transition admission from delivered C/E-F authorities.

G2 — Recovery [AC-5, INV-4]: reconcile ProductHistory against registered closure-relevant authority heads; any uncommitted drift yields RECOVERY_REQUIRED until the exact missing transition is appended from immutable canonical refs.
G3 — Acceptance authority [AC-6, AC-8, INV-6]: add product-acceptance-policy.js with immutable policy/waiver artifacts, CAS current head, complete waiver derivation and waiverSetDigest.

G4 — Projection [AC-1, AC-2, AC-4, AC-5, AC-6, INV-1, INV-2, INV-3, INV-6]: add product-state-projection.js; build from product/root only, pin one ProductProjectionSubject, derive complete current claims/obligations/release/quality/blockers, and persist a content-addressed projection.

G5 — Closure/currentness [AC-3, AC-6, AC-7, AC-9, INV-5, INV-7]: add product-closure.js; close only an ELIGIBLE projection after guarded subject recheck; currentOutcome revalidates the historical claim against the current projection subject.

G6 — Durable proof [AC-1..AC-9, INV-1..INV-8]: export controllers/stores and verify fresh-process rebuild, omission resistance, crash recovery, race fencing, immutable-history conflicts, post-closure revalidation, and strategy-only non-invalidation.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Omitting a current QUALITY_REJECTED claim from caller input cannot make the product eligible; the builder derives it from canonical history and returns NOT_READY.
evidenceRequired: Canonical history derives rejected quality; caller omission cannot hide it.

evidenceRequired: Hn projection cannot close after Hn+1 transition.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Deleting any cached ProductStateProjection and rebuilding from the same pinned subject yields identical readiness, active-set identity and blockers.
evidenceRequired: Same pinned subject rebuilds identical readiness/active-set/blockers.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Restarting a fresh process can reconstruct the same current product subject and projection from durable history/policy refs without prior conversation state.
